tool_summary: Builds a filesystem on a device or partition, destroying any existing data on that target.
platform_notes: mkfs and its filesystem-specific variants (mkfs.ext4, mkfs.xfs, etc.) are GNU/Linux tools. macOS uses newfs instead. This ruleset targets Linux only.
notes: commandant resolves rulesets by exact binary name (see posix_parser.cr: binary = tokens.first). mkfs.ext4, mkfs.xfs, etc. are each parsed as a distinct binary and will NOT match this file -- they require sibling ruleset files (mkfs.ext4.json, mkfs.xfs.json, ...). This file covers bare mkfs invocations (e.g. mkfs -t ext4 /dev/sdb1) only.

rules.description: Writes a new filesystem structure to a target device or partition, unconditionally destroying any existing data there. There is no dry-run or confirmation built into the tool itself.
